sections.heading: Proposal Summary
sections.text: This proposal, SYN-SYNCP000031-P1, was presented by GSK PHARM (the Supplier) to Highland Pediatric Center 031 on November 12, 2025.

sections.heading: Supplier Concession
sections.text: Supplier concession: an administrative fee of 1.75%.

sections.heading: Supplier Request
sections.text: Supplier request: a Shingles share floor of 70%.

sections.heading: Proposal Status
sections.text: Status of this proposal: countered by the Customer.
